Saudi Aramco Halts Crude Oil Supply to European Refiners

Saudi Aramco has informed at least two European refining customers that they will receive no crude oil in the upcoming month. This decision follows an attack on a key Saudi pipeline that supplies oil to the Red Sea. The information was reported by Bloomberg News.
